title: DeviceRegistrationResponse
description: server -> device, the 200 body of POST /devices/register (device-registration.schema.json). `connector_url` is the phone's secret MCP connector URL — present only when this call created the device, and never returned again: the server keeps only a hash of the secret inside it. A device that registers again with the same key (200, no `connector_url`) and has lost the URL recovers by connecting and sending `regenerate_secret`. Other statuses: 400 invalid body, 409 the device_id is registered with a different key, 429 registration rate limit (Retry-After header).

connector_url.description: The full URL to paste into an MCP client, secret included. Treat as a credential.
